messages:
Olivia M: Putting a check-in here after the postmortem. We saw delayed ingestion for ~10-14 hours that undercounted tokens on the pro-tier export path. Need a short remediation playbook and owners so we don't keep repeating this.
Derek: I can take the telemetry and infra side. Preliminary root cause looks like the consumer lag compounding with a dedupe window mismatch.
Priya S: I will own customer remediation + credit calc. I want a reproducible repro so we can validate corrected totals before issuing credits.
Jules: I'll handle the invoice corrections flow and the ledger entries. Need to know cutoffs for issuing credits vs adjustments.
FinanceBot: Scan result: 52 customers with variance >2%; 12 customers >15%. Estimated gross exposure ~ $21,400.
Olivia M: Proposal for rules: auto-credit if corrected delta > $200 and >3% of monthly spend. Manual review required above $3k. Any objections?
Priya S: That sounds reasonable. For edge cases we should run a manual audit with support and account teams.
Derek: Technical action plan: 1) add a consumer watermark check to prevent overlapping backfills 2) tighten dedupe key semantics 3) add an oncall alert if ingestion lag > 10m for 30m. ETA for staging code: 48h.
Jules: Process action plan: 1) draft invoice correction template 2) create journal entry checklist 3) determine SLA for credit issuance (target 10 business days). I can draft and share by EOD tomorrow.
Priya S: For comms I prefer two tracks: a short proactive email to affected customers with corrected totals and a support playbook for incoming tickets. I can draft both once I have the validated CSV.
Derek: I will also run a 14-day retro scan to see if this pattern has happened before. If we see a repeating cadence, we should consider a weekly ingestion integrity job.
Olivia M: Good call. Add acceptance criteria for engineers: reconciled tokens match raw producer logs for a random 72-hour window within 0.3%. Also include reproducible test in CI.
FinanceBot: Reminder: attach the reconciliation artifacts to the ticket. Missing artifacts will block credit approvals.
Jules: Legal — please confirm if our proposed credit thresholds need an updated clause in TOS or just standard comms. Tagging @Legal.
Legal: We need to review wording for any admission of fault. We can approve credits but recommend phrasing that focuses on corrected accounting rather than apology language. Share sample text and thresholds.
Derek: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/metering/pull/987 implementing watermark guard and idempotent consumer. Putting test scripts in metering/tests/repro/flow_sim.py
Priya S: Uploaded preliminary impacted list to /shared/finance/recon/1790001111_pre_fix.csv. Note these are pre-fix numbers. I will swap with post-fix CSV after Derek confirms staging run.
Olivia M: Action owners recap:
- Derek: implement fix, run staging replay, provide post-fix CSV and logs (48h)
- Priya S: prepare customer comm templates and credit calc, run manual audits for >$3k (start after Derek results)
- Jules: invoice correction template + ledger checklist + propose SLA (EOD tomorrow)
- Legal: review messaging and thresholds (ASAP)
- FinanceBot: block credits without reconciliation artifacts attached
Derek: I'll also add a recurring dashboard tile that shows ingestion lag + reconciliation drift week-over-week. Plan to propose a weekly guardrail sync after this incident.
Priya S: Once final numbers exist, I'll prepare an aggregated summary and per-account breakdown for support and account teams.
Jules: Will draft the journal entry examples and share links to the GL codes we should use.
Olivia M: Let's schedule a 30m follow-up on Friday 10:30am to confirm staging outcome and sign off on list for credits. If Derek shows the fix is clean we can proceed with comms.
Derek: Noted. I'll post logs and the reconciled CSV here.
FinanceBot: Automated follow-up scheduled in 72h to verify reconciliation artifacts exist in /shared/finance/recon/1790001111_post_fix.csv
Olivia M: thanks all 44d add anything missing or ping me directly if you need help escalating.
